## Development setup
0. Requirement: Zig `[version](../build.zig.zon#L8)` installed
1. Clone the repository:
   ```bash
   git clone https://github.com/ziex-dev/ziex
   cd ziex
   ```
2. Building the Ziex CLI:
   ```bash
   zig build
   ```
3. Running tests:
   ```bash
   zig build test
   ```
